title: Ammonia in three dimensions
hook: Turn a model of NH₃ and examine its shape.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Nitrogen has three bonding regions and one lone pair. The atoms form a trigonal pyramid; the lone pair is not shown as an atom.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: Nitrogen has three bonding regions and one lone pair. The atoms form a trigonal pyramid; the lone pair is not shown as an atom.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: Nitrogen has three bonding regions and one lone pair. The atoms form a trigonal pyramid; the lone pair is not shown as an atom.
The stage is a schematic model and is not drawn to scale.

recall.question: What is the molecular shape of NH₃ around its central atom?
